notes.title: Discrete structure theory of logic
notes.detailedDescription:
1. Academic Note-Making
Note-making is the active process of recording key information from a source in a structured, concise manner. 
Structure: Effective notes typically follow a hierarchical format including a Title, Sub-headings to organize sections, and Points/Sub-points for specific details.
Key Techniques:
Conciseness: Use phrases instead of complete sentences to save time.
Abbreviations & Symbols: Utilize shortened forms (e.g., "fin." for financial) to condense data. A key to these abbreviations should be included at the end.
Visual Aids: Use underlining, indentation, and color to make key points stand out.
Purpose: It helps in filtering important information, aids in long-term memory retention, and serves as a quick revision tool for exams.
